name: CodeBlock
label: Code block
description: Monospace code with a header and one-click copy, optional highlighting, line numbers and tabs.

props.name: code
props.description: The code to display, as a plain string. Required unless `lines` or `tabs` supply it.

props.name: lines
props.description:
The code highlighted, one array of tokens per line, as returned by
`highlight()` from `rift-ds/code/highlight`. Each token is coloured by
its role. Without it the code is monochrome. When `code` is left out,
the copy button copies the text of these lines.

props.name: language
props.description: Language tag shown in the header, e.g. "tsx", "css"

props.name: filename
props.description: Filename shown in the header, e.g. "tokens-light.css"

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Show a line number before each line.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: Line numbers (counted from 1) to mark with a highlighted background, e.g. the lines a step changed.

props.name: tabs
props.description:
Several snippets behind a row of tabs in the header (an install command
for each package manager, the same example in two languages). Replaces
the filename and language. `packageManagerTabs()` from `rift-ds/code`
writes the install case.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected tab's value (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially selected tab's value (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the tab's value when the reader picks a tab.

props.name: syncKey
props.description:
Share the selected tab with every CodeBlock on the page that has the
same key, and remember it for the reader's next visit (in
localStorage). Ignored while `value` is controlled.

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

props.name: showCopy
props.description: Show the copy-to-clipboard button

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Called with the copied text (the shown tab's code, or the text of `lines`) as it is sent to the clipboard, through the async API or its textarea fallback (the write is not awaited), so a host can count copies.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the block; code scrolls vertically inside while the header stays pinned. Numbers are px.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Show a chevron beside the filename that collapses/expands the code area

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Start collapsed (only applies when collapsible)

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the copy button before it is pressed

props.name: copyText
props.description: Visible text on the copy button before it is pressed

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name the copy button shows once the code is copied

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the collapse toggle while the code is collapsed

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the collapse toggle while the code is showing

props.name: codeLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for the scrollable code region. Defaults to
"Code: <filename>", then "Code: <language>", then "Code".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

CodeBlockTab.description: One snippet in a tabbed CodeBlock.

CodeLine.description: One line of highlighted code: its runs, in order, with no newline.

CodeToken.description: One run of code text, optionally marked with a syntax role.

CodeTokenRole.description: A syntax role a highlighter marks a run of code with. Each is coloured by its `--color-code-*` token.

rows.text: Opens what it controls, and closes it when it is open.
Moves focus into the list at the selected tab, and out of the list on the next press.
Moves to the next tab and selects it.
Moves to the previous tab and selects it.
Moves to the last tab and selects it.
Moves to the first tab and selects it.
